name: Panelra – Custom Admin Dashboard Builder
author: davelabs

sections.description:
Panelra is a custom dashboard builder and admin UI plugin for WordPress that helps you simplify, customize, and control the entire admin experience.

🎥 Watch the full Panelra tutorial:
https://youtu.be/O-Xx98nyBu4?si=FmQd1T25pp8wOVyh

Instead of dealing with cluttered dashboards, plugin notices, and confusing menus, you can:

  • Create your own custom dashboard
  • Hide unnecessary elements
  • Simplify the admin for clients or team members
  • Customize the look and feel of WordPress

Custom Dashboard Builder (Core Feature)

Create a fully custom dashboard using a visual builder.

  • Build your own layout with sections and columns
  • Add content blocks (text, headings, buttons, images, videos, stats)
  • Show different content based on user roles
  • Remove all default WordPress widgets
  • Hide admin notices for a clean experience

Turn the default dashboard into a useful control panel for your business or your clients.

Clean & Simplify the Admin

Panelra helps you remove distractions and improve usability:

  • Hide admin notices globally
  • Remove default dashboard widgets
  • Clean up the admin interface
  • Hide Screen Options and Help tabs
  • Reduce visual clutter

Customize the Admin UI

Make WordPress look and feel like your own platform:

  • Change admin colors
  • Customize typography
  • Adjust layout spacing

Admin Menu & Role Management

Control what users see in the admin:

  • Rename menu items
  • Hide menu items per role
  • Simplify navigation for clients
  • Reduce confusion for non-technical users

Maintenance Mode

Quickly put your site in maintenance mode:

  • Enable/disable with one click
  • Display a custom message
  • Restrict access to logged-in users

Activity Log

Track important admin actions:

  • Monitor user activity
  • See key events in the backend
  • Useful for debugging and control

Who is this plugin for?

Panelra is perfect for:

  • Freelancers building websites for clients
  • Agencies managing multiple projects
  • Site owners who want a cleaner admin
  • Anyone who wants to simplify WordPress

Free vs Pro

The free version gives you everything you need to:

  • Clean the admin
  • Customize UI
  • Build a custom dashboard

Panelra Pro (coming soon) will unlock:

  • Advanced dashboard blocks (HTML, forms, files)
  • Full white label mode
  • Role-based rules engine
  • Advanced menu control (drag & drop, reorder)
  • Client mode & onboarding dashboard
  • Export/import configurations

How it works

  1. Install and activate Panelra
  2. Go to Panelra → Dashboard Builder
  3. Enable the custom dashboard
  4. Build your layout visually
  5. Save and view your new dashboard

Developer Friendly

  • Clean architecture
  • Filters for extending block types
  • Hooks for custom integrations

Notes

  • Works with most themes and plugins
  • Designed to be lightweight and fast
  • Does not modify core WordPress behavior permanently

Feedback

We’re actively improving Panelra.

If you like it:
⭐ Leave a review
💬 Share feedback
🚀 Suggest features
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen
  3. Go to Panelra in the admin menu
  4. Start customizing your dashboard
sections.faq:
Can I use this for client websites?

Yes. Panelra is perfect for simplifying the admin for clients.

Does it affect frontend users?

No. It only modifies the WordPress admin area.

Can I hide dashboard widgets?

Yes. You can remove all default widgets and replace them with your own dashboard.

Can I create different dashboards for different roles?

Yes. You can control visibility of sections and blocks by user role.

Is coding required?

No. Everything is done visually.
